proof_scope: For a word of k negative fields in a bounded boundary union, the middle convolution generic rank is at most k times the product of dimensions. At odd arity there is no punctual term at 1, and the normalized trace mean costs O(k p^(-1/2)+|S| p^(-1)) times that product.

At the actual height-600 predictor on Q, the first outgoing physical derivative difference and its secant average have explicitly summable odd-word representations. For the full all-power frozen signed insertion with two translated columns the sum of maximum entry bounds is O(n^(-0.467)), uniformly over the actual first segment and all sufficiently large eligible primes.

The same word expansion supplies the actual second outgoing counting secant with norm below 0.518 and hence the genuine product of the first and second physical secants below 0.267. This uses existing outward fixed-height packet data and exact rational comparisons. No upper cutoff on prime size is used.

The same geometric estimate with the off-base boundary moment gives the actual fixed-height-601 transported kernels a summed maximum-entry bound O(n^(-0.45)) on Q. The height-600 exponent 0.467 is retained for the signed linear insertion, without a claim that it holds for the full new kernels.
failed_paths_and_open_bounds: The raw API budget requires uniform arithmetic representations at a genuine moving starter and does not supply that starter. A per-time summed estimate alone need not control the varying-time absolute sums; the termwise bounds must be uniform.

The two actual fixed steps and their arithmetic bounds do not give uniformly confined iteration to growing depths, a residual at the needed quadratic scale, a common cold complex domain, the original theta limit, or a prime upper on the independent real obstruction.
replay_checks: Nine prefactor, curvature, contraction and exponent inequalities were evaluated with exact rational arithmetic. Existing outward height-600 packet inputs retain their earlier scope. Raw API response and completion receipt are preserved.
independent_review: A read-only Astra audit checked uniform-in-arity boundary moments, odd-parity mean and exceptions, actual outgoing derivatives, all-power insertion sum, both counting secants and the translated height-601 interpolation.
